lineage.reason: Derived from Meta facebook/omniASR, not from any NVIDIA line, so it satisfies the stated exclusion.

contract.graph_input: x float32 [batch, num_samples], raw 16 kHz waveform
contract.frontend: none required; the wav2vec2 convolutional extractor is inside the graph
contract.vocab_format: tokens.txt, one token per line with an id, containing real spaces rather than the U+2581 marker
contract.length_input: none; decode one waveform at a time

artifacts.note: The INT8 build is dynamically quantized for this repository and is a quarter of the FP32 size.

oracle.source: Model card spot check: four Common Voice 17 clips (por_0, por_1, swh_0, swh_1) with reference, hypothesis and CER/WER
oracle.use: Provides an independent reference transcript to score a port against, not merely self-consistency of the same graph.
oracle.caveat: Those four clips are not in the repository, so scoring requires the upstream clips or substituting an equivalent oracle such as the upstream model.

why_worth_porting: Raw-waveform input removes any feature-extractor parity work, unlike the 80-bin Parakeet frontend.
CTC decoding reuses the shared CtcDecoder and the tokenizer pattern just proven with parakeet-ctc.
Breadth over 1600 languages is a differentiator from the 25-language Orukeet and single-language ctaguchi ports.
blocking_prerequisite: Authority to download a 328 MB INT8 graph (or 1.3 GB FP32). The AGENTS.md rule requires approval for new large weight downloads; the user authorized scope but not this specific download.
already_delivered_this_session: ctaguchi/parakeet-hf-ctc-110m-en is ported, harness-verified and browser-warm-up verified; this is the next candidate, not a prerequisite for it.
